title: Current-main Staging Admin Remote Runtime target catalog read-only projection

phases.objective: Expose the existing Remote Runtime target catalog through a dedicated Staging Admin GET-only projection while preserving shared Admin Core operation budgets, canonical read-only service behavior, exact environment classification, and fail-closed generated policy convergence.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: GET /platform/remote-runtime/targets/catalog-readonly through the Staging Admin schema
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The Staging Admin schema exposes only the bounded GET catalog projection, returns no credential values, performs no SSH/filesystem/provider/deployment mutation, remains excluded from shared Admin Core, and all generated Staging policy artifacts converge deterministically.
steps: Resolve the dedicated precise GET contract and Operational Console route under the existing backend API key and admin-principal guards.
List Remote Runtime targets through the canonical read-only service using query-only filters and bounded limits.
Prove the operation is excluded from shared Admin Core while the Staging-only schema composes it directly.
Regenerate dependent OpenAPI, Activation Gateway Staging policy, convergence hashes, Remote MCP inventory, and portable Staging manifest through governed writers.
Run environment-impact closure requiring explicit Staging and Production review while keeping Production mutation disallowed.
assertions: No target upsert, validation mutation, SSH execution, shell execution, filesystem access, credential payload read, deployment authority, Breakglass, raw SQL, or Production mutation is introduced.
The canonical POST catalog remains unchanged and the new projection accepts query input only.
The operation does not consume a shared Admin Core Custom GPT operation slot.
Staging live certification remains required because shared runtime/OpenAPI and Staging policy surfaces change.
production_mutation_allowed remains false and secrets_included remains false.
The critical declaration is registered in Constitution.control_plane_paths and convergence.automation_control_paths before merge.
The precise registry writer accepts only the exact predecessor whose sole drift is the reviewed admin-control tag promotion; any other predecessor drift remains fail-closed.

The governed OpenAPI refresh regenerates the mutation-policy fingerprint after base Custom GPT schema generation and synchronizes the Staging smart-convergence expected policy hash after profile hash convergence.

phases.objective: This PR does not authorize Production deployment, Production provider mutation, target mutation, credential mutation, SSH execution, filesystem execution, or write-surface promotion.
blockers: Production mutation requires a separate governed promotion and explicit authorization.
This PR is limited to a read-only Staging Admin projection and shared source-contract safety.
